title.zh: 3-year-old bug triggers $1.3 million drain and forces 10-day blockchain halt
title.en: 3-year-old bug triggers $1.3 million drain and forces 10-day blockchain halt

current_state.zh: A three-year-old Radix Engine bug, introduced in a 2023 code refactor and missed by an external audit, enabled a roughly $1.3 million vault drain and forced validators to halt the Radix blockchain for 10 days.
current_state.en: A three-year-old Radix Engine bug, introduced in a 2023 code refactor and missed by an external audit, enabled a roughly $1.3 million vault drain and forced validators to halt the Radix blockchain for 10 days.
